note: Style chung của kênh — mọi prompt đều mở bằng khối này để các ảnh cùng một 'máy quay'.
style: candid wildlife photograph taken in the field for a nature documentary, living animal with real skin pores, moisture, dirt and small scars, natural light, telephoto lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain
creatureTreatment: the creature is a real living animal but keeps its exact recognizable Pokémon silhouette, proportions, colors and markings
plateStyle: field reference photograph of a living wild animal standing on flat bare ground in soft overcast outdoor light, plain muted background far out of focus, whole body sharp, real skin pores, moisture, dirt and small scars
note2: Thử Flow 2026-09-22: plate kiểu 'studio, phông trơn' ra ảnh như mô hình đồ chơi -> chuyển sang chụp ngoài trời, nền mờ.
sceneStyle: candid nature documentary photograph, natural light, telephoto lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, no animals
anatomyStyle: scientific x-ray style study plate for a field research notebook, deep desaturated teal-green backdrop, the animal rendered as a translucent luminous silhouette with the skeleton and the internal energy pathways glowing softly inside it, clean even study lighting, faint anatomical grid behind the subject, no photographic skin detail
anatomyTreatment: the creature keeps its exact recognizable Pokémon silhouette, proportions and markings; only the outer body is made translucent so the structure underneath reads, the body stays whole and intact and closed
fieldNoteStyle: a single page from a naturalist's research notebook in the manner of Darwin's and Leonardo da Vinci's study sheets, photographed flat from directly above, aged off-white paper with visible fibre and a faint ruled grid, one main graphite and ink study of the animal plus several smaller separate detail studies drawn apart from it on the same page, each detail isolated and studied on its own like a specimen, loose construction lines and light cross-hatching, the drawings occupying the LEFT TWO THIRDS of the page, the RIGHT THIRD of the page left completely empty and blank, soft even daylight, slight paper curl
fieldNoteTreatment: the drawing keeps the creature's exact recognizable Pokémon silhouette, proportions and markings, rendered as a hand drawn pencil and ink naturalist study with visible construction lines and light hatching, not a photograph
note3: anatomy và fieldnote là hai kind riêng, mỗi cái có style + treatment + forbidden của nó. fieldnote CỐ Ý chừa trống một phần ba bên phải và cấm mọi thứ giống chữ VÀ mọi mũi tên — chữ và mũi tên đều do Remotion vẽ lên, vì AI sinh chữ ra ký tự méo (tiếng Việt có dấu méo nặng hơn) và mũi tên AI vẽ thì chỉ sai chỗ mà không sửa được. Ảnh chỉ là giấy và hình vẽ.

sizes.extreme-wide: extreme wide landscape shot, the creature a tiny figure in a vast environment, the land itself is the subject
sizes.wide: wide establishing shot, the whole creature visible small within its habitat, environment dominant
sizes.medium: medium shot, the whole creature filling about half the frame with its immediate surroundings
sizes.close: close-up, the creature's head and upper body filling most of the frame
sizes.macro: extreme macro close-up on a single anatomical detail, filling the whole frame

angles.eye: camera at the creature's own eye level
angles.low: low angle from ground level looking up at the creature, making it feel large
angles.high: high angle looking down onto the creature from above
angles.overhead: straight top-down overhead view looking directly down
angles.rear: shot from behind the creature, its back toward camera, seeing what it sees
angles.profile: strict side profile, creature facing across the frame
angles.pov: from the creature's point of view at its eye height, the creature itself not in frame

motionReady: the creature fills most of the frame and is the only subject, completely still air, no wind, soft even overcast light, background calm and softly out of focus
note4: size / angle / motion là ba trường của shot, chọn từ lúc viết prompt. motion:true dành cho ảnh sẽ chạy creature-motion: creature-motion chỉ làm động được CON VẬT, nên mọi thứ trong cảnh vốn phải động (tia nắng, gió, cỏ lay, nước) mà đứng im sẽ trông như ảnh hỏng. Ảnh có những thứ đó thì gửi sang Veo, đừng ép creature-motion.
locationStyle: candid landscape photograph taken in the field for a nature documentary, an empty natural environment with no animals present, natural light, telephoto and wide lenses, subtle film grain, the place itself is the subject
studyPrefix: separate isolated detail studies drawn apart on the same page, each studied on its own
note5: Trang sổ kiểu Darwin/da Vinci: không chỉ vẽ cả thân mà BÓC TỪNG CHI TIẾT ra vẽ riêng — một cái móng, một con mắt, một bẹ lá, một mảng da, một dấu chân. 'Bóc tách' ở đây là tách hình vẽ ra khỏi thân để nghiên cứu, KHÔNG phải mổ xẻ: chỉ bộ phận nhìn thấy từ bên ngoài, không nội tạng. Khai trong shot bằng trường studies; 'footprint' lấy đúng dấu chân canon từ bible sinh vật.
